title: 日経新春杯の後に・急襲！新ライバル

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I did it… I ran properly… Hehehe…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Trainer, you know… I'm finally feeling a little more confident!
She's true to her word. This is a huge leap in terms of growth. Not to mention…
choice_data_list: (Her running has certainly gotten better too—that's for sure.)

text_block_list.text: She stands her ground, even in a high-pace senior graded race. If she keeps this up…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Do you think I can do it now?! Run with Opera O in a senior G1?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: You can't go running with Opera O just yet. There still stands one opponent you must defeat!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Heaven calls upon me, Buddha as my witness. Spirits begone, vanquished by the spinach leaf!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: You want to run with Opera O? Then do so after defeating me, Matikanefukukitaru!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh, Fukukitaru? But I thought we were kindred spirits…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Why yes, we are. However… I assure you my challenge comes with a profound and esoteric meaning.
I get the feeling Matikanefukukitaru is planning something, I can't be completely sure though.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Then, that settles it! This challenge will take place nowhere other than…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen at the end of the year!
choice_data_list: Isn't that a little far away?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Then, how about the Kinko Sho?
A swift and easy response. With that, it's decided—the friends will face off in the Kinko Sho this March.
